facts.fact: Cave 专程离田送谜语：影子——「背对时我最靠近你，面对时我就消失」
facts.anchor: I wear the shape of everything but have no shape of my own

facts.fact: Ares 说 Cave 开场后从不离田——他破例只为送这则谜语
facts.anchor: He normally never comes in once the chases start. He refuses to let his cornfield be empty

facts.fact: 储藏室里 Kayla 先立规：若被利用就永久离开
facts.anchor: if you use this to get something from me, I will walk away and won’t come back

facts.fact: Ares 复述规则并接受，随后第一次在她面前放下墙
Kayla 的直觉两次报警：巷中背影与屋内被注视感
facts.anchor: I have learned to listen to my instincts when they scream that something isn’t right

facts.fact: 她发信息给 Clay，只求有人知道
facts.anchor: I know it’s late, but the feeling is back. I just wanted someone to know

facts.fact: Clay 已坐在她 loft 桌边，自称「有办法」进门
章末 Kayla 以自嘲确认四人亲密已成日常，Clay 守夜无声
facts.anchor: since I am now getting laid on a regular basis, it calls for a lot more maintenance
